identity_rule: Copy source order, unit and shipment identifiers. Relation IDs join the relation role and both IDs with colons. No synthetic identifier aliases a chapter object.
transformation: Copy values unchanged. Fixed relation kinds are selected by source associations; their locators name the association field, not literal enum text.
locator_convention: row:N:field, zero-based JSONL row; unit_ids[i] selects one unit.
query_scope: Recorded order units minus units assigned through its shipments. No delivery, stock allocation, source truth, or duplicate-assignment enforcement claim.
